decisions.reason: SOL drops 네 입으로, the order to speak from his own mouth.
중진 is a senior figure, not merely a senior.
Tighter spoken report of 스물셋이 전부입니다 without padding.
좌중 as 'the gathering' avoids stiff 'those present.'
피하기 어려운 is hard to avoid, not unavoidable.
지부 here is the family's branches as a campaign target, not one branch.
했다고 했습니다 as hearsay reads more naturally as 'I was told.'
했겠지 is speculative; SOL makes the inference a stated fact.
전했느냐 is who delivered/conveyed the intel; 'gave you' is merely different.
생각하느냐 refers to the messenger claim; 'believe it' can shift the object to the intel.
Italicizing this SFX alone breaks the chapter's unitalicized Ding/Smack convention.
SOL loses 눈빛이 쏟아졌다, the gaze pouring down like fire.
Cleaner split of the dismissal beat; 'return' and 'for the time being' stay faithful.
냉철하게 현실을 바라보다 is look at reality, not assess the situation.
decisions.replacement: Now it was time to look at reality with a cool head.

decisions.reason: 현재 상황은 is the situation, not our current position.
Tighter staff report; 'severe' fits 큰 피해 better than 'bad.'
Keeps the Twin Devils memorial fragment and does not add 'the thought.'
Drops the calqued 'someone who' without losing 흐름을 바꿀 수 있는.
Particle placement is merely different, not better.
Preserves the 평판이…… trail-off instead of filling in 'will suffer.'
'Outnumber them by more than two to one' and 'number of Peak masters' match 두 배가 넘는 and 숫자.
개박살 is crude smash/wreck, not a generic crush.
'Forget' hits the 불호령 harder than 'don't worry about.'
Restores 하지만 and makes the failed persuasion target explicit.
'Also' is redundant with 'is one thing, but' and is not in 동요하고.
놈들 is derogatory 'fools'; 멍청한 is dumb, not absurd.
decisions.replacement: *Are there really fools stupid enough to believe a rumor that dumb?*

decisions.reason: Fixes BASE's 'that that'; 치가 떨렸다 is clenched teeth, not grinding.
decisions.replacement: As if it weren’t enough that the pathetic fool Jin Taekyung had poisoned his son, now he had supposedly killed a Peak master too. The scheme was obvious. Lee Cheonbaek’s teeth clenched at the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s despicable tactics.

decisions.reason: Tighter barked order; 헛소문 remains 'nonsense.'
SOL adds unsupported 'further' to 사기는 떨어지겠지만.
Keeps 은원의 고리; 'their chain' is ambiguous.
Needs 혀를 내둘렀다 and 뽀얀; SOL's 'smooth' is unsupported.
decisions.replacement: The physician clicked his tongue in amazement. It was my second day since I’d come to. Overnight, the scabs had fallen away, and pale new skin had grown in.

decisions.reason: More spoken under the ten-year frame without losing 처음 봅니다.
Makes 회복 속도 explicit as recovery speed.
SOL adds hedging 'could' and pluralizes 효력.
Comma is merely different and slightly nonrestrictive.
Keeps present-tense 완전 치유; SOL past-tenses and swaps healing for recovery.
차라리 잘됐다 is 'just as well'; SOL hedges and stiffens 의심을 피하기.
'Like I was' matches Jin's voice; 'as though I were' is too formal.
'Attribute to' fits the physician's wondering register better than slangy 'pin on.'
어리둥절한 is lost/bewildered, not plain confusion.
Keeps spoken 'get just because you have money'; SOL stiffens and adds 'enough.'
밀려왔다 is a wash of regret, not just 'I felt a pang.'
Tighter cause for 폭주; 'obeying' is the right verb for unruly energy.
일회용 is the disposable-item metaphor; SOL turns it into 'blew it all.'
Attribution belongs on the same line as the short quote.
Merges speaker tag and dialogue into one natural beat.
'Such' pre-intensifies 아깝다 before 아까워 죽겠다.
SOL adds 'Damn' and drops 죽겠다.
'Inside me' is padding on 뿌듯함이 밀려온다.
나름대로 is 'something of a master'; SOL adds unsupported 'a few.'
decisions.replacement: It felt like only yesterday I’d been shaking in front of some two-bit bandits. Now I was something of a master. My Level had jumped after I took down Jopil, and I’d gained a massive amount of Fame.

decisions.reason: 'Remaining' is the natural collocation for 남아 있는 기운.
Two-item list should not take a comma before and.
남발 is repeated firing/spam, matching Jin's gamer diction, not general recklessness.
First-person 'I' fits the thought better than generic 'you.'
이 게임…다르다 makes the game/setting different; SOL shifts the subject to I.
Uses 신체 능력 and 활용도; SOL's 'above me' specifies a direction 차이 does not.
decisions.replacement: Here I was a martial artist with fifteen years of internal energy and physical abilities superior to NPCs with a twenty- or thirty-Level gap. Changing the vessel that held the power had revealed how versatile the Skill had always been.

decisions.reason: SOL adds unsupported 'struggled to' onto 무공을 익히던.
Resolves the omitted chanting subject as 'people' instead of vague 'they.'
The 이니 listing lands as separate epithet beats.
나부랭이 is already 'two-bit' in this chapter; 'lowly' breaks that rendering.
SOL changes 손 to fingers, adds 'pampered,' and weakens 빼곡하게.
쓰러트린 is 'taken down,' matching the surrounding verb.
Same omitted-subject fix as the chanting line: people, not they.
그래 is Yeah; 말해 보자면 stays present, not past.
나쁘지 않은 is 'not bad' in present thought, not past 'half bad.'
Fixes BASE's 'across' while keeping 부양해야 하는 가장 as the breadwinner who had to support them.
decisions.replacement: I ate and slept in a one-room goshiwon barely ten square meters in size,[^1] the breadwinner who had to support my family. I couldn’t become a hero, and I didn’t want to.

decisions.reason: 'While praying' makes 기도하며 simultaneous with the fighting.
하지 못하는 is present inability; SOL past-perfects it and turns 적들 into 'their enemies.'
'In front of me' is the spoken rendering; 'before me' is merely more literary.
SOL drops 문득 from the sudden laugh.
Needs both 어느새 and 발견했다; BASE stacks them awkwardly, SOL drops the finding.
decisions.replacement: Before I knew it, I’d found that I was enjoying living as Jin Taekyung, a martial artist of Murim. Because this was a game. Because it could turn every impossibility into a possibility.

decisions.reason: 수 있다 is 'could,' and 퍼져 나갈수록 is the more rumors spread, not farther.
문제는 따로 있다 is a different problem; SOL adds unsupported 'real.'
